name: Later
description_en:
Later Social is a hosted social content workspace combining visual planning, scheduling, collaboration and reporting. The current pricing groups a Social Set as one profile on each of eight supported networks, while Access Groups organize media, profiles and people. Later also markets enterprise influencer services and creator affiliate tools; those are separate product routes, not automatically included Social features.

It suits a team that needs to coordinate a calendar and inspect channel-specific publishing conditions. A useful evaluation follows a campaign from incomplete drafts through review, quota consumption and delivery, then compares available analytics. The important boundaries include drafts consuming post allowance, Stories requiring different publishing paths, approval roles that can still publish without approval, and account moves that can remove a Link in Bio page. This is public-documentation research without account operations or measured marketing outcomes.
description_zh:
Later Social 是托管社交内容工作区，结合可视规划、排程、协作及报告。现行定价把 Social Set 定义为八个支持网络各一个账户，Access Groups 则组织媒体、账户与人员。Later 另提供企业网红服务、创作者联盟工具，属于独立产品路径，不能自动计入 Social 权益。

它适合需协调日历并检查各渠道发布条件的团队。有效评估应跟踪活动从未完成草稿到审阅、额度消耗、投递，再比较可得分析。关键边界包括草稿占帖子额度、Stories 使用不同发布路径、审批角色仍可能无需批准发布，以及移动账户可能删除 Link in Bio 页面。本研究仅阅读公开文档，未操作账户或测量营销效果。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Annual-selected USD pricing: Starter $18.75/month, Growth $37.50, Scale $82.50, billed yearly; the page displays 25% savings. Included Social Sets/users are 1/1, 2/2 and 6/4; monthly posts per profile 30, 180 and unlimited. Starter has no add-ons. Growth/Scale selected-view add-ons list $11.25/month per set and $3.75 per user; taxes extra. The current approval page advertises a 14-day no-card trial. Help still documents a Free plan with 12 posts/profile/month, but availability to a new signup was not established. No normalized monthly-billed or renewal-promotion price assigned.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 页面所选年付 USD 价：Starter 每月 $18.75、Growth $37.50、Scale $82.50，按年收费，显示节省 25%。包含 Social Sets／用户分别为 1／1、2／2、6／4，每账户月帖 30、180、不限。Starter 无附加项，Growth／Scale 当前所选视图每 Set 月 $11.25、每用户 $3.75，另加税。现行审批页宣传无需银行卡的 14 天试用。帮助仍记录每账户月 12 帖 Free，但新注册能否取得未确定。不分配按月收费或续费优惠的标准化价格。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Start with the Social product and the actual account mix
sections.title_zh: 从 Social 产品及实际账户组合开始
sections.en: A Social Set contains one profile per supported network. Buying a set is a capacity decision; creating an Access Group is an organizational decision. The general workflow covers planning, approval, publishing, engagement and analysis, but format support and paid entitlements must be checked separately. Editorial launch example: list the exact brand accounts, assets and responsible people first, then choose set capacity and group access. Do not assume an enterprise influencer campaign service is part of a Social subscription.
sections.zh: 一个 Social Set 包含每个支持网络各一个账户。购买 Set 是容量决策，建立 Access Group 是组织决策。总体流程涵盖规划、审批、发布、互动及分析，格式支持与付费权益需另查。编辑发布示例：先列出准确品牌账户、素材及负责人，再选 Set 容量和分组访问。不能假设企业网红活动服务包含在 Social 订阅。

sections.title_en: Moving an account can change more than access
sections.title_zh: 移动账户不只改变访问权
sections.en: Only the account owner creates Access Groups. Invitations initially include the default, earliest-created group unless access is removed, so an invitation should not be assumed isolated to a new client group. Moving a social profile carries its posts and schedules, while media moves separately. The guide warns that moving an Instagram profile permanently deletes its Link in Bio page; a new page retains linked posts but loses its design and buttons. Media transfers remove labels and do not move posts. Editorial handover: inventory the page, media and existing access before reorganizing a client.
sections.zh: 仅账户所有者可建立 Access Groups。邀请起初自动包含默认、最早创建的分组，除非移除访问，不能假设邀请只隔离到新客户组。移动社交账户会带走帖子及排程，媒体需另移。指南警告移动 Instagram 账户会永久删除 Link in Bio 页面，新页面保留关联帖子但丢失设计及按钮。媒体转移移除标签且不移动帖子。编辑交接建议：重组客户前清点页面、媒体及现有访问。

sections.title_en: Allowance is consumed when content is created
sections.title_zh: 创建内容时就消耗额度
sections.en: The post counter resets at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month, independently of the billing date. Drafts and scheduled posts count when created, not when published; scheduling an existing draft does not count it twice. Deleting a scheduled post restores capacity only if it has not published and was created in the same month. Editorial planning example: preparing next month’s campaign today can consume this month’s allowance. Check creation activity as well as the visible publication calendar before assuming the available count is wrong.
sections.zh: 帖子计数每月一日 UTC 00:00 重置，与账单日独立。草稿及计划帖在创建时计数，并非发布时；排程已有草稿不重复计算。删除计划帖仅在未发布且同月创建时退额度。编辑规划示例：今天准备下月活动可能消耗本月额度。判断剩余计数是否错误前，同时检查创建活动及可见发布日历。

sections.title_en: Review does not universally block publication
sections.title_zh: 审阅并非普遍阻止发布
sections.en: An incomplete draft stays unpublished even when it contains a date. The draft guide says multi-profile drafts must later be scheduled individually and draft posts do not appear in Share Instagram Calendar. Current approval marketing supports internal and account-free external feedback on Growth and above, but its FAQ adds a critical exception: Members can request approval yet their scheduled posts publish regardless of approval status. Reviewers can approve and their Publish Without Approval permission cannot be disabled. Editorial acceptance: inspect role and scheduled state rather than treating the presence of comments or an approval request as a mandatory publishing gate.
sections.zh: 未完成草稿即使有日期也不发布。草稿指南说多账户草稿之后须逐个排程，草稿不出现在 Share Instagram Calendar。现行审批产品页支持 Growth 以上内部及无需账户的外部反馈，但 FAQ 有关键例外：Member 可请求审批，其计划帖仍不论审批状态照常发布；Reviewer 可批准，其 Publish Without Approval 权限不能禁用。编辑验收建议：检查角色及排程状态，不能把评论或审批请求视为强制发布门槛。

sections.title_en: Stories use a different publishing and recovery path
sections.title_zh: Stories 使用不同发布及恢复路径
sections.en: The current Stories guide requires a paid plan and desktop scheduling for one Instagram profile at a time. Business profiles can Auto Publish; Creator profiles use notification publishing. Native elements such as stickers, polls or music require completion through the notification path. Stories do not support Later team collaboration/content approval. In a multi-frame Auto Publish sequence, one failed frame causes following frames to fail to preserve order. Editorial campaign check: choose the supported account and format, assign someone to complete notification posts, and verify the whole sequence after a failure rather than assuming later frames continued.
sections.zh: 现行 Stories 指南要求付费计划、桌面排程，每次一个 Instagram 账户。Business 可自动发布，Creator 使用通知发布。贴纸、投票、音乐等原生元素需经通知路径完成。Stories 不支持 Later 团队协作／内容审批。多帧自动发布序列一帧失败会令后续帧失败以保持顺序。编辑活动检查：选择支持账户及格式，指定人员完成通知帖，失败后验证整个序列，不能假设后续帧继续。

sections.title_en: Recommended time can be personalized or a fallback
sections.title_zh: 推荐时间可能个性化，也可能采用后备数据
sections.en: The Best Time to Post guide distinguishes network-specific methods. Facebook uses the last 50 posts and falls back to global recommendations when data is insufficient. TikTok requires a Business account, offers one suggested time per day and also has a global fallback. Instagram personalization requires an eligible professional profile. Starter has a 24-hour trial of the multi-select feature, while Growth and higher retain access. Editorial experiment: record which recommendation basis was available, then compare observed results across an appropriate period. A suggested time is not evidence that it caused additional engagement.
sections.zh: Best Time to Post 指南区分各网络方法。Facebook 使用最近 50 帖，数据不足采用全球建议。TikTok 需 Business 账户，每天建议一个时刻，也有全球后备。Instagram 个性化需合格专业账户。Starter 的多选功能试用 24 小时，Growth 以上持续可用。编辑实验建议：记录可得推荐依据，再在合适周期比较观察结果。建议时间不能证明它造成额外互动。

sections.title_en: Use the current metric guide and preserve entitlement conflicts
sections.title_zh: 使用现行指标指南并保留权益冲突
sections.en: The dedicated analytics guide updated October 21, 2026 lists Instagram history of three months on Starter, one year on Growth and two years on Scale; Instagram audience data requires at least 100 followers. It lists LinkedIn personal profiles and Pages and longer Threads history on higher tiers. The September reference instead says LinkedIn personal profiles only and three months of Threads history across tiers, and differs on some paid-report entitlements. These discrepancies remain unresolved. Editorial procurement: confirm the specific network, metric and history inside the intended account before relying on it. Reporting availability and Link in Bio traffic do not independently establish incremental sales.
sections.zh: 2026 年 10 月 21 日更新的分析专页列出 Instagram 历史：Starter 三个月、Growth 一年、Scale 两年；受众数据需至少 100 关注者。它包含 LinkedIn 个人与 Pages，并为高档列出更长 Threads 历史。9 月总表却写 LinkedIn 仅个人、Threads 各档三个月，一些付费报告权益也有差异，冲突未解决。编辑采购建议：依赖前在目标账户确认准确网络、指标及历史。报告可得性及 Link in Bio 流量不能独立证明增量销售。

sections.title_en: Connection recovery does not finish notification posts
sections.title_zh: 恢复连接不会代为完成通知帖
sections.en: The troubleshooting guide separates expired social connections from notification posts that a person never finished and missing iOS photo permissions. Refreshing an expired connection is documented to restore future publishing, not as proof that an earlier failed post was replayed. The retrieved general failure guide is dated January 2024; its numerical Instagram API limit was not adopted as a current universal platform limit. Editorial incident check: inspect the native destination, connection and publishing method, correct the stated cause, and verify a controlled reschedule. No automatic retry timing or duplicate-prevention contract was verified.
sections.zh: 故障指南区分社交连接到期、人员未完成通知发布、iOS 照片权限缺失。文档说刷新到期连接恢复未来发布，不能证明此前失败帖已重放。所读通用故障页日期为 2024 年 1 月，其 Instagram API 数字限制未作为当前平台普遍限制采用。编辑故障检查：查看原生目的地、连接及发布方式，修正所示原因，并验证可控重排。未核实自动重试时间或防重复契约。

sections.title_en: Removing resources and stopping charges are separate actions
sections.title_zh: 移除资源与停止收费是独立动作
sections.en: The add-on guide limits additional users/Social Sets to eligible Growth or Scale desktop subscriptions. Added capacity is prorated; removing a person or social profile alone does not cancel the corresponding plan add-on. Removal keeps access through the current paid period without an unused-period refund. Failed-payment documentation describes retries before a downgrade to Free: already scheduled posts continue publishing but cannot be edited without upgrading. Updating payment details may collect an outstanding invoice, and canceling renewal does not erase it. Editorial offboarding: inspect the actual subscription and queued content, not just connected accounts.
sections.zh: 附加项指南将新增用户／Social Sets 限于合格 Growth、Scale 桌面订阅。增加容量按比例收费，单独移除人员或社交账户不取消对应计划附加项。移除后可用至当前已付周期结束，未用时段不退款。付款失败文档说明重试后降到 Free，已有计划帖仍发布，但不升级就不能编辑。更新付款资料可能收取欠付账单，取消续费不抹去欠款。编辑退出建议：检查真实订阅及队列内容，不能只看已连接账户。
